title: kate-core: keep a hash comment inside a fold
summary: A hash comment line is blank for indent folds. It does not start a fold and it does not end one. The test goes in the existing fold tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fold.rs is a private module of view.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Do not add a second module with the same name. Change only line_indent. Trim a trailing carriage return first. Let body be line.trim_start_matches of space and tab. One if returns early. if body.starts_with('#') { return LineIndent { blank: true, indent: 0 }; }. Then keep the existing match on leading_indent. Do not nest an if inside an if. A hash after other text is not a comment. Do not touch indent_folds, fold_at, leading_indent, innermost_fold, span_contains_line, next_content, or fold_end. The existing tests nested_indent_makes_two_spans and a_blank_line_stays_inside_the_outer_span stay green. The test a_hash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold calls indent_folds of a, newline, two spaces, # note, newline with tab width 4 and gets an empty vector. The same call on a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, # end, newline gets one FoldSpan with start 0 and end 4. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: view::fold::tests::a_hash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A hash comment under a starts a fold through the trailing blank line. After the change that text has no fold. A hash line at column 0 no longer ends the fold of a and b.
